# Cynwra

*Page PDF 14*

THE CORSAIRS OF CAPTAIN FL ARIEL 

## **Cynwra**
Two years ago, Cynwra of the Alwan clan lived an uneventful existence in the region of Albion known as Morien. She toiled as a shepherdess, showed respect to the land, and negotiated the hardships of life on the remote, rain-lashed isle. One day, she trudged from the hills into her village with her flock and stumbled upon a vision of horror. The clan’s warriors lay slaughtered in the mud, while her kinsfolk huddled, chained together, overseen by a lithe figure taunting them with a pack of savage hounds. 

## **Cynwra — Human Oarswoman**
| M | WS | BS | S | T | I | Ag | Dex | Int | WP | Fel | W |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 30 | 30 | 40 | 35 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 35 | 13 |

**Traits:** Prejudice (Elves), Weapon +6

**Skills:** Cool 35, Dodge 35, Endurance 50, Row 60

**Talents:** Old Salt, Sea Legs, Stone Soup, Strong Back

**Trappings:** Chains, Crude Shiv (hidden under bench), Ragged Garments

Cynwra is a captive on the Raptor’s Talon, condemned to man the oars in the galley. The trials of servitude have taken their toll on her body, yet her mind remains resolute and her spirit unbroken. She takes solace in the teachings of the Truthsayers of her homeland, who taught her that the Seven Gods of Light will always strive to repel the darkness. As her fellow villagers succumbed to the viciousness of Corvian, she became steely in her loathing for the Druchii. Over time, she forged bonds with the other captives and schemes in whispers to lead an uprising against her cruel captors. All she needs is the right opportunity.
